from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from shopsphere.common import (
    AOV_FALLBACK, BASE_FEATURES, CAMPAIGN_TYPES, CATEGORIES, CHANNELS,
    CUSTOMER_FEATURES, DATA_DIR, DELIVERY_STATUS, DEVICE, MARGIN_FALLBACK,
    MODEL_FEATURES, OUT_DATA, PAYMENTS, ROLLING_MODELS, SHIP_SPEEDS,
    SUPPORT_CHANNELS, TICKET_CATS, TIERS, TRAFFIC, counts, ensure_dirs,
    offer_catalogue, offer_cost_series, read_budget, read_csv, resolve_as_of,
    sample_ref, shares, to01, window_bounds,
)
from shopsphere.data import asof_features as af
from shopsphere.data.asof_time import parse_datetime
from shopsphere.models.scoring import RollingScorer


def days_between(as_of: pd.Series, dates: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return (as_of - parse_datetime(dates)).dt.days


def base_contact_frame(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    c = read_csv("customers.csv")
    c["signup_date"] = parse_datetime(c["signup_date"])
    c["email_open_rate_missing"] = c["email_open_rate"].isna().astype(int)
    c["has_referral"] = c["referral_code"].notna().astype(int)
    c["tier_ord"] = c["customer_tier"].map({"Bronze": 0, "Silver": 1, "Gold": 2, "Platinum": 3})
    c = c.rename(columns={
        "age": "cust_age", "country_code_clean": "cust_country", "region": "cust_region",
        "loyalty_score": "cust_loyalty", "email_open_rate": "cust_email_open",
        "discount_usage_rate": "cust_discount_rate", "avg_review_score": "cust_review",
        "customer_tier": "cust_tier", "credit_limit": "cust_credit_limit",
        "email_open_rate_missing": "cust_email_open_missing",
    })
    base = c[[
        "customer_id", "cust_age", "cust_country", "cust_region", "signup_date",
        "cust_loyalty", "cust_email_open", "cust_email_open_missing",
        "cust_discount_rate", "cust_review", "has_referral", "cust_tier", "tier_ord",
        "cust_credit_limit",
    ]].copy()

    geo = read_csv("geo_data.csv").rename(columns={
        "geo_ip_region": "cust_region", "average_income": "geo_income",
        "urban_ratio": "geo_urban", "internet_penetration": "geo_internet",
        "region_tier": "geo_tier",
    })
    base = base.merge(geo, on="cust_region", how="left")

    pref = read_csv("customer_preferences.csv")
    pref["last_updated"] = parse_datetime(pref["last_updated"])
    for col in ["email_opt_in_clean", "sms_opt_in_clean", "do_not_contact_clean"]:
        pref[col] = to01(pref[col])
    pref = pref.rename(columns={
        "email_opt_in_clean": "pref_email_opt", "sms_opt_in_clean": "pref_sms_opt",
        "preferred_channel": "pref_channel", "preferred_language": "pref_language",
        "do_not_contact_clean": "pref_dnc",
    })
    base = base.merge(
        pref[["customer_id", "pref_email_opt", "pref_sms_opt", "pref_channel",
              "pref_language", "pref_dnc", "last_updated"]],
        on="customer_id", how="left",
    )

    out = contacts.merge(base, on="customer_id", how="left")
    out["tenure_days"] = days_between(out["contact_date"], out["signup_date"])
    out["pref_days_since_update"] = days_between(out["contact_date"], out["last_updated"])
    out = out.drop(columns=["signup_date", "last_updated"])

    budget = read_budget().groupby("country")["retention_budget_usd"].mean()
    out["country_avg_weekly_budget"] = out["cust_country"].map(budget)

    offers = offer_catalogue()
    offers = offers.rename(columns={
        "value": "offer_value", "requires_promotable": "offer_requires_promotable",
        "counts_monthly": "offer_counts_monthly",
    })
    out = out.merge(
        offers[["offer_code", "offer_type", "offer_value", "offer_requires_promotable",
                "offer_counts_monthly", "eligible_tiers", "tier_list"]],
        on="offer_code", how="left",
    )

    def tier_match(tier, tier_list) -> int:
        if isinstance(tier_list, str):
            tier_list = [tier_list]
        if tier_list is None:
            return 0
        names = [str(t).strip() for t in tier_list]
        if any(t.lower() == "all" for t in names):
            return 1
        return int(str(tier) in names)

    out["tier_offer_match"] = [
        tier_match(t, v) for t, v in zip(out["cust_tier"], out["tier_list"])
    ]
    out["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = (
        out["channel"].astype(str) == out["pref_channel"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)
    out = out.drop(columns=["eligible_tiers", "tier_list"])
    return out


def session_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read_csv(
        "shopsphere_sessions_cleaned.csv",
        usecols=["customer_id", "session_timestamp", "session_duration", "pages_viewed",
                 "cart_additions", "campaign_id", "traffic_source_clean",
                 "device_type_clean", "bounce_clean", "campaign_status"],
    )
    s["event_date"] = parse_datetime(s["session_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    s["_bounce"] = to01(s["bounce_clean"])
    s["_camp"] = (s["campaign_status"] == "Has Campaign").astype(int)
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(s, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sess_n"] = g.size()
    f["sess_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["sess_tenure_days"] = g["days_before"].max()
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"sess_n_{d}d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= d).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()
    for col, out in [("session_duration", "dur"), ("pages_viewed", "pages"),
                     ("cart_additions", "cart")]:
        f[f"sess_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"sess_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"sess_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["sess_dur_std"] = g["session_duration"].std()
    f["sess_bounce_rate"] = g["_bounce"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_rate"] = g["_camp"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_n"] = g["_camp"].sum()
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "traffic_source_clean", TRAFFIC, "sess_src_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "device_type_clean", DEVICE, "sess_dev_"))

    camp = read_csv("marketing_campaigns.csv", usecols=["campaign_id", "campaign_type"])
    sm = m[["contact_id", "campaign_id"]].dropna(subset=["campaign_id"]).copy()
    sm["campaign_id"] = sm["campaign_id"].astype("int64")
    sm = sm.merge(camp, on="campaign_id", how="left")
    f = f.join(shares(sm, "contact_id", "campaign_type", CAMPAIGN_TYPES, "sess_camptype_"))
    return f


def transaction_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    t = read_csv(
        "transactions.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp", "order_value",
                 "items_count", "payment_method", "discount_applied_clean",
                 "shipping_speed", "high_value_flag_clean"],
    )
    t["event_date"] = parse_datetime(t["transaction_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    t["_disc"] = to01(t["discount_applied_clean"])
    t["_high"] = to01(t["high_value_flag_clean"])
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(t, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["txn_n"] = g.size()
    f["txn_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["txn_tenure_days"] = g["days_before"].max()
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"txn_n_{d}d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= d).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()
        f[f"txn_spend_{d}d"] = m.assign(
            _v=np.where(m["days_before"] <= d, m["order_value"], 0.0)
        ).groupby("contact_id")["_v"].sum()
    for col, out in [("order_value", "value"), ("items_count", "items")]:
        f[f"txn_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"txn_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"txn_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["txn_value_std"] = g["order_value"].std()
    f["txn_value_median"] = g["order_value"].median()
    f["txn_discount_rate"] = g["_disc"].mean()
    f["txn_high_value_rate"] = g["_high"].mean()
    last = m.sort_values(["contact_id", "event_date"]).groupby("contact_id")
    f["txn_last_value"] = last["order_value"].last()
    f["txn_last_items"] = last["items_count"].last()
    f["txn_spend_per_day"] = f["txn_value_sum"] / f["txn_tenure_days"].replace(0, np.nan)
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "payment_method", PAYMENTS, "txn_pay_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "shipping_speed", SHIP_SPEEDS, "txn_ship_"))
    return f, m


def item_block(txn_events: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    items = read_csv("transaction_items.csv")
    products = read_csv(
        "products.csv", usecols=["product_id", "category", "margin_pct", "is_promotable_clean"]
    )
    items = items.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
    items["line_value"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"]
    items["_promo"] = to01(items["is_promotable_clean"]).fillna(0)
    m = txn_events[["contact_id", "transaction_id", "event_date", "days_before"]].merge(
        items, on="transaction_id", how="inner"
    )

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["item_lines"] = g.size()
    f["item_qty"] = g["quantity"].sum()
    f["item_list_value"] = g["line_value"].sum()
    f["item_weighted_margin"] = (
        m.assign(_w=m["line_value"] * m["margin_pct"]).groupby("contact_id")["_w"].sum()
        / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    low_margin = m.assign(
        _lm=np.where(m["margin_pct"] < 0.25, m["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("contact_id")["_lm"].sum()
    f["item_low_margin_share"] = low_margin / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    promo_value = m.assign(
        _pv=np.where(m["_promo"] == 1, m["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("contact_id")["_pv"].sum()
    f["item_promotable_share"] = promo_value / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)

    cat = m.groupby(["contact_id", "category"])["line_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.reindex(columns=CATEGORIES, fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.div(cat.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
    cat.columns = [f"item_cat_{c}" for c in cat.columns]
    return f.join(cat)


def delivery_block(txn_events: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = read_csv(
        "deliveries.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "carrier", "ship_date", "delivered_date", "delay_days",
                 "delivery_status"],
    )
    d["ship_date"] = parse_datetime(d["ship_date"])
    m = txn_events[["contact_id", "transaction_id", "contact_date", "event_date"]].merge(
        d, on="transaction_id", how="inner"
    )
    m = m[m["ship_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["_late"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Delivered Late").astype(int)
    m["_lost"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Lost").astype(int)
    m["_returned"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Returned").astype(int)
    m["_transit"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "In Transit").astype(int)

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["del_n"] = g.size()
    f["del_carriers"] = g["carrier"].nunique()
    f["del_late_rate"] = g["_late"].mean()
    f["del_lost_rate"] = g["_lost"].mean()
    f["del_returned_rate"] = g["_returned"].mean()
    f["del_transit_rate"] = g["_transit"].mean()
    f["del_delay_mean"] = g["delay_days"].mean()
    f["del_delay_max"] = g["delay_days"].max()
    f["del_delay_sum"] = g["delay_days"].sum()
    f["del_last_status_late"] = (
        m.sort_values(["contact_id", "ship_date"]).groupby("contact_id")["_late"].last()
    )
    return f


def support_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read_csv(
        "support_tickets.csv",
        usecols=["ticket_id", "customer_id", "created_date", "channel_clean", "category",
                 "priority", "status", "first_response_hours", "resolution_hours", "csat_score"],
    )
    s["event_date"] = parse_datetime(s["created_date"]).dt.normalize()
    s["_open"] = (s["status"] == "Open").astype(int)
    s["_high"] = (s["priority"] == "High").astype(int)
    s["_low_csat"] = (s["csat_score"] <= 2).astype(int)
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(s, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sup_n"] = g.size()
    f["sup_open_n"] = g["_open"].sum()
    f["sup_high_n"] = g["_high"].sum()
    f["sup_low_csat_n"] = g["_low_csat"].sum()
    f["sup_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["sup_csat_mean"] = g["csat_score"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_mean"] = g["first_response_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_max"] = g["first_response_hours"].max()
    f["sup_res_mean"] = g["resolution_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_res_max"] = g["resolution_hours"].max()
    f["sup_n_90d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= 90).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()

    complaint_cats = ["Late delivery", "Damaged or wrong item", "Lost parcel", "Refund status"]
    recent = m[(m["days_before"] <= 90) & (m["category"].isin(complaint_cats))]
    f["sup_recent_complaint"] = f.index.isin(recent["contact_id"]).astype(int)
    f = f.join(counts(m, "contact_id", "category", TICKET_CATS, "sup_cat_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "channel_clean", SUPPORT_CHANNELS, "sup_ch_"))
    return f


def historical_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    contacts = read_csv("retention_contact_history.csv")
    contacts["contact_date"] = parse_datetime(contacts["contact_date"])
    contacts["purchased_within_14d"] = to01(contacts["purchased_within_14d_clean"]).fillna(0).astype(int)
    contacts["redeemed"] = to01(contacts["redeemed_clean"])

    feats = base_contact_frame(contacts)
    print("  sessions")
    sess = session_block(contacts)
    print("  transactions")
    txn, txn_events = transaction_block(contacts)
    print("  items")
    items = item_block(txn_events)
    print("  deliveries")
    deliv = delivery_block(txn_events)
    print("  support")
    sup = support_block(contacts)

    feats = feats.merge(txn, left_on="contact_id", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats["expected_order_value"] = np.where(
        feats["txn_n_90d"].fillna(0) > 0,
        feats["txn_spend_90d"] / feats["txn_n_90d"].replace(0, np.nan),
        feats["txn_value_mean"],
    )
    feats["expected_order_value"] = feats["expected_order_value"].fillna(AOV_FALLBACK)
    feats["offer_cost"] = offer_cost_series(feats)

    for block in (sess, items, deliv, sup):
        feats = feats.merge(block, left_on="contact_id", right_index=True, how="left")

    feats["margin"] = feats["item_weighted_margin"].fillna(MARGIN_FALLBACK)
    feats["item_promotable_share"] = feats["item_promotable_share"].fillna(0.0)

    count_cols = [
        "sess_n", "sess_n_30d", "sess_n_90d", "sess_n_180d", "sess_n_365d",
        "sess_campaign_n", "txn_n", "txn_n_30d", "txn_n_90d", "txn_n_180d",
        "txn_n_365d", "item_lines", "item_qty", "del_n", "sup_n", "sup_open_n",
        "sup_high_n", "sup_low_csat_n", "sup_n_90d",
    ] + [f"sup_cat_{c}" for c in TICKET_CATS]
    for col in count_cols:
        if col in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0)
    for col in ["sup_recent_complaint"]:
        if col in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    for col in MODEL_FEATURES:
        if col not in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = np.nan
    feats["offer_requires_promotable"] = feats["offer_requires_promotable"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["offer_counts_monthly"] = feats["offer_counts_monthly"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["tier_offer_match"] = feats["tier_offer_match"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = feats["contact_channel_is_preferred"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return feats


def rolling_live_snapshot() -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "live_scores.pkl")
    if os.path.exists(path):
        print(f"  using rolling live scores from {path}")
        return pd.read_pickle(path)

    as_of = resolve_as_of(None, DATA_DIR)
    raw = af.load_raw(DATA_DIR)
    cur = af.build_snapshot(raw, as_of, DATA_DIR, labelled=False)
    scorer = RollingScorer()
    cur["w1_probability"] = scorer.predict_proba(cur)
    cur["w1_target"] = (cur["w1_probability"] >= scorer.threshold).astype(int)
    cur["w1_as_of"] = pd.Timestamp(as_of)
    start, end = window_bounds(as_of, af.WINDOW_DAYS)
    cur["w1_window_start"] = start
    cur["w1_window_end"] = end
    return cur


def current_snapshot() -> pd.DataFrame:
    cur = rolling_live_snapshot()
    cur["sample_ref"] = sample_ref(cur["customer_id"])

    as_of = pd.Timestamp(cur["w1_as_of"].iloc[0]) if "w1_as_of" in cur else \
        resolve_as_of(None, DATA_DIR)
    r = read_csv("retention_contact_history.csv", usecols=["customer_id", "contact_date"])
    r["contact_date"] = parse_datetime(r["contact_date"])
    r = r[r["contact_date"] <= as_of]
    last = r.groupby("customer_id")["contact_date"].max().rename("last_contact_date")
    cur = cur.drop(columns=["last_contact_date"], errors="ignore")
    return cur.merge(last, left_on="customer_id", right_index=True, how="left")


def main() -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    print("Building historical contact features ...")
    hist = historical_features()
    hist.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "historical_contacts.pkl"))

    print("Building current customer snapshot ...")
    cur = current_snapshot()
    cur.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "current_customers.pkl"))

    offers = offer_catalogue().drop(columns=["tier_list"])
    offers.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "offer_catalogue_clean.csv"), index=False)

    rolling_meta_path = os.path.join(ROLLING_MODELS, "rolling_meta.json")
    rolling_meta = {}
    if os.path.exists(rolling_meta_path):
        with open(rolling_meta_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            rolling_meta = json.load(fh)
    score_as_of = cur["w1_as_of"].iloc[0] if "w1_as_of" in cur else None
    score_window_start = cur["w1_window_start"].iloc[0] if "w1_window_start" in cur else None
    score_window_end = cur["w1_window_end"].iloc[0] if "w1_window_end" in cur else None
    summary = {
        "historical_contacts": int(len(hist)),
        "historical_customers": int(hist["customer_id"].nunique()),
        "historical_purchase_rate": round(float(hist["purchased_within_14d"].mean()), 5),
        "current_customers": int(len(cur)),
        "current_w1_mean": round(float(cur["w1_probability"].mean()), 5),
        "current_w1_high_share": round(float(cur["w1_target"].mean()), 5),
        "score_as_of": str(pd.Timestamp(score_as_of).date()) if score_as_of is not None else None,
        "score_window_start": str(pd.Timestamp(score_window_start).date()) if score_window_start is not None else None,
        "score_window_end": str(pd.Timestamp(score_window_end).date()) if score_window_end is not None else None,
        "w1_model": rolling_meta.get("selected_model"),
        "w1_threshold": rolling_meta.get("selected_threshold"),
        "model_features": len(MODEL_FEATURES),
        "categorical_features": [c for c in MODEL_FEATURES if c in
                                  ["cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier", "geo_tier",
                                   "pref_channel", "pref_language", "offer_code", "channel",
                                   "offer_type"]],
    }
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "prep_summary.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

324: def standardized_lift(offer_df: pd.DataFrame, none_df: pd.DataFrame,
325:                       strata: list[str]) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
326:     overall = float(none_df["purchase"].mean())
327:     observed = float(offer_df["purchase"].mean())

329:     rates = none_df.groupby(strata)["purchase"].mean()
330:     expected = float((weights * rates.reindex(weights.index).fillna(overall)).sum())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from shopsphere.common import (
    ANALYTICS_REPORTS, OUT_DATA, ensure_dirs, read_csv, region_country_map, to01,
)
from shopsphere.data.asof_time import parse_datetime

STRATA = ["cust_tier", "country", "channel"]


def customer_map() -> pd.DataFrame:
    c = read_csv("customers.csv", usecols=["customer_id", "region", "country_code_clean"])
    return c.rename(columns={"region": "cust_region", "country_code_clean": "country"})


def daily_country() -> pd.DataFrame:
    cust = customer_map()
    tx = read_csv(
        "transactions.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp", "order_value",
                 "items_count"],
    )
    tx["date"] = parse_datetime(tx["transaction_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    tx = tx.merge(cust[["customer_id", "country", "cust_region"]], on="customer_id", how="left")

    sess = read_csv("shopsphere_sessions_cleaned.csv", usecols=["customer_id", "session_timestamp"])
    sess["date"] = parse_datetime(sess["session_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    sess = sess.merge(cust[["customer_id", "country", "cust_region"]], on="customer_id", how="left")

    camp = read_csv(
        "marketing_campaigns.csv",
        usecols=["campaign_id", "campaign_type", "region_target", "start_date", "end_date",
                 "status", "campaign_budget"],
    )
    rmap = region_country_map()
    camp["country"] = camp["region_target"].map(rmap)
    perf = read_csv("campaign_daily_performance.csv")
    perf["date"] = parse_datetime(perf["date"]).dt.normalize()
    perf = perf.merge(
        camp[["campaign_id", "campaign_type", "region_target", "country"]],
        on="campaign_id", how="left",
    )

    d = read_csv(
        "deliveries.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "carrier", "ship_date", "delivered_date", "delay_days",
                 "delivery_status"],
    )
    d["date"] = parse_datetime(d["delivered_date"]).fillna(parse_datetime(d["ship_date"]))
    d["date"] = d["date"].dt.normalize()
    d = d.merge(tx[["transaction_id", "country", "cust_region"]], on="transaction_id", how="left")
    d["_late"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Delivered Late").astype(int)
    d["_lost"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Lost").astype(int)
    d["_returned"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Returned").astype(int)

    tx_daily = tx.groupby(["date", "country"], dropna=False).agg(
        revenue=("order_value", "sum"),
        orders=("transaction_id", "nunique"),
        items=("items_count", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    sess_daily = sess.groupby(["date", "country"], dropna=False).agg(
        sessions=("customer_id", "size"),
    ).reset_index()
    perf_daily = perf.groupby(["date", "country"], dropna=False).agg(
        campaign_spend=("spend", "sum"),
        impressions=("impressions", "sum"),
        clicks=("clicks", "sum"),
        attributed_sessions=("attributed_sessions", "sum"),
        attributed_orders=("attributed_orders", "sum"),
        attributed_revenue=("attributed_revenue", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    del_daily = d.groupby(["date", "country"], dropna=False).agg(
        deliveries=("transaction_id", "size"),
        late_deliveries=("_late", "sum"),
        lost_deliveries=("_lost", "sum"),
        returned_deliveries=("_returned", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    out = tx_daily.merge(sess_daily, on=["date", "country"], how="outer")

    num_cols = ["revenue", "orders", "items", "sessions", "campaign_spend", "impressions",
                "clicks", "attributed_sessions", "attributed_orders", "attributed_revenue",
                "deliveries", "late_deliveries", "lost_deliveries", "returned_deliveries"]
    for col in num_cols:
        out[col] = pd.to_numeric(out[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    out = out.dropna(subset=["date", "country"]).sort_values(["date", "country"])
    out["aov"] = out["revenue"] / out["orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    out["conversion_rate"] = out["orders"] / out["sessions"].replace(0, np.nan)
    out["campaign_roas"] = out["attributed_revenue"] / out["campaign_spend"].replace(0, np.nan)
    out["late_rate"] = out["late_deliveries"] / out["deliveries"].replace(0, np.nan)
    out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_daily_country.csv"), index=False)
    return out


def country_scorecard(daily: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    end = pd.Timestamp(daily["date"].max())
    last_start = end - pd.Timedelta(days=89)
    prior_end = last_start - pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    prior_start = prior_end - pd.Timedelta(days=89)

    def agg(start, end_date, suffix):
        d = daily[(daily["date"] >= start) & (daily["date"] <= end_date)]
        g = d.groupby("country").agg(
            revenue=("revenue", "sum"), orders=("orders", "sum"), items=("items", "sum"),
            sessions=("sessions", "sum"), campaign_spend=("campaign_spend", "sum"),
            attributed_revenue=("attributed_revenue", "sum"),
            deliveries=("deliveries", "sum"), late=("late_deliveries", "sum"),
        )
        g["aov"] = g["revenue"] / g["orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
        g["conversion"] = g["orders"] / g["sessions"].replace(0, np.nan)
        g["roas"] = g["attributed_revenue"] / g["campaign_spend"].replace(0, np.nan)
        g["late_rate"] = g["late"] / g["deliveries"].replace(0, np.nan)
        return g.add_suffix(suffix)

    out = agg(last_start, end, "_last90").join(agg(prior_start, prior_end, "_prior90"), how="outer")
    out["revenue_change_pct"] = (
        out["revenue_last90"] / out["revenue_prior90"].replace(0, np.nan) - 1
    )
    out["orders_change_pct"] = (
        out["orders_last90"] / out["orders_prior90"].replace(0, np.nan) - 1
    )
    out["conversion_change"] = out["conversion_last90"] - out["conversion_prior90"]
    out["aov_change_pct"] = out["aov_last90"] / out["aov_prior90"].replace(0, np.nan) - 1
    out = out.reset_index()
    out["period_end"] = end.date().isoformat()
    out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_country_scorecard.csv"), index=False)
    return out

def campaign_did() -> pd.DataFrame:
    cust = customer_map()
    tx = read_csv(
        "transactions.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp", "order_value"],
    )
    tx["date"] = parse_datetime(tx["transaction_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    tx = tx.merge(cust[["customer_id", "cust_region", "country"]], on="customer_id", how="left")
    reg_daily = tx.groupby(["date", "cust_region"], dropna=False).agg(
        revenue=("order_value", "sum"), orders=("transaction_id", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()
    all_regions = sorted(cust["cust_region"].dropna().unique())
    revenue = reg_daily.pivot_table(index="cust_region", columns="date", values="revenue",
                                    fill_value=0.0, aggfunc="sum").reindex(all_regions, fill_value=0.0)
    orders = reg_daily.pivot_table(index="cust_region", columns="date", values="orders",
                                   fill_value=0.0, aggfunc="sum").reindex(all_regions, fill_value=0.0)

    rmap = region_country_map()
    camp = read_csv(
        "marketing_campaigns.csv",
        usecols=["campaign_id", "campaign_type", "region_target", "start_date", "end_date",
                 "status", "campaign_budget"],
    )
    camp["start_date"] = parse_datetime(camp["start_date"])
    camp["end_date"] = parse_datetime(camp["end_date"])
    camp["country"] = camp["region_target"].map(rmap)
    regions_by_country = {
        c: sorted([r for r in all_regions if rmap.get(r) == c])
        for c in camp["country"].dropna().unique()
    }

    rows = []
    for _, c in camp.iterrows():
        if pd.isna(c["start_date"]) or pd.isna(c["end_date"]) or pd.isna(c["country"]):
            continue
        start, end = c["start_date"], c["end_date"]
        post_days = (end - start).days + 1
        if post_days <= 0:
            continue
        pre_end = start - pd.Timedelta(days=1)
        pre_start = pre_end - pd.Timedelta(days=post_days - 1)
        active = camp[(camp["start_date"] <= end) & (camp["end_date"] >= start)]
        blocked = set(active["region_target"].dropna())
        control = [r for r in regions_by_country.get(c["country"], [])
                   if r not in blocked and r != c["region_target"]]
        if len(control) < 3:
            continue
        target = c["region_target"]
        if target not in revenue.index:
            continue
        tpre = revenue.loc[target, pre_start:pre_end].sum()
        tpost = revenue.loc[target, start:end].sum()
        cpre = revenue.loc[control, pre_start:pre_end].sum().sum()
        cpost = revenue.loc[control, start:end].sum().sum()
        tpre_o = orders.loc[target, pre_start:pre_end].sum()
        tpost_o = orders.loc[target, start:end].sum()
        cpre_o = orders.loc[control, pre_start:pre_end].sum().sum()
        cpost_o = orders.loc[control, start:end].sum().sum()
        if tpre_o < 5 or tpost_o < 5:
            continue
        tpre_d = tpre / post_days
        tpost_d = tpost / post_days
        cpre_d = cpre / (post_days * len(control))
        cpost_d = cpost / (post_days * len(control))
        did = (tpost_d - tpre_d) - (cpost_d - cpre_d)
        rows.append({
            "campaign_id": int(c["campaign_id"]),
            "campaign_type": c["campaign_type"],
            "country": c["country"],
            "target_region": target,
            "start_date": start.date().isoformat(),
            "end_date": end.date().isoformat(),
            "post_days": int(post_days),
            "n_control_regions": len(control),
            "target_pre_daily_revenue": round(float(tpre_d), 2),
            "target_post_daily_revenue": round(float(tpost_d), 2),
            "control_pre_daily_revenue": round(float(cpre_d), 2),
            "control_post_daily_revenue": round(float(cpost_d), 2),
            "did_daily_revenue": round(float(did), 2),
            "relative_lift": round(float(did / tpre_d), 5) if tpre_d else None,
            "target_pre_orders": int(tpre_o),
            "target_post_orders": int(tpost_o),
            "control_pre_orders": int(cpre_o),
            "control_post_orders": int(cpost_o),
        })
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if len(out):
        out = out.sort_values("relative_lift", ascending=False)
    out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_campaign_did.csv"), index=False)
    return out

def standardized_lift(offer_df: pd.DataFrame, none_df: pd.DataFrame,
                      strata: list[str]) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
    overall = float(none_df["purchase"].mean())
    observed = float(offer_df["purchase"].mean())
    weights = offer_df.groupby(strata).size().div(len(offer_df))
    rates = none_df.groupby(strata)["purchase"].mean()
    expected = float((weights * rates.reindex(weights.index).fillna(overall)).sum())
    return observed, expected, observed - expected, overall


def offer_lift() -> pd.DataFrame:
    r = read_csv("retention_contact_history.csv")
    r["purchase"] = to01(r["purchased_within_14d_clean"]).fillna(0).astype(int)
    r["redeemed"] = to01(r["redeemed_clean"])
    c = read_csv("customers.csv", usecols=["customer_id", "customer_tier", "country_code_clean"])
    r = r.merge(c.rename(columns={"customer_tier": "cust_tier",
                                   "country_code_clean": "country"}),
                on="customer_id", how="left")
    r["channel"] = r["channel"].astype(str)
    none = r[r["offer_code"] == "OFF-NONE"].copy()
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    rows = []
    for offer in sorted([o for o in r["offer_code"].unique() if o != "OFF-NONE"]):
        sub = r[r["offer_code"] == offer].copy()
        if len(sub) < 20:
            continue
        observed, expected, lift, overall_none = standardized_lift(sub, none, STRATA)
        boots = []
        for _ in range(300):
            b_offer = sub.iloc[rng.integers(0, len(sub), len(sub))]
            b_none = none.iloc[rng.integers(0, len(none), len(none))]
            _, _, b_lift, _ = standardized_lift(b_offer, b_none, STRATA)
            boots.append(b_lift)
        lo, hi = np.percentile(boots, [2.5, 97.5])
        rows.append({
            "offer_code": offer,
            "contacts": int(len(sub)),
            "observed_purchase_rate": round(observed, 5),
            "expected_baseline_rate": round(expected, 5),
            "adjusted_lift": round(lift, 5),
            "lift_ci_low": round(float(lo), 5),
            "lift_ci_high": round(float(hi), 5),
            "incremental_purchases": round(lift * len(sub), 2),
            "redemption_rate": round(float(sub["redeemed"].mean()), 5),
            "overall_none_rate": round(overall_none, 5),
        })
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("adjusted_lift", ascending=False)
    out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_offer_lift.csv"), index=False)
    return out


def seasonality_analytics() -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    cust = customer_map()
    tx = read_csv(
        "transactions.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp", "order_value"],
    )
    tx["date"] = parse_datetime(tx["transaction_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    tx["month"] = tx["date"].dt.to_period("M").dt.to_timestamp()
    tx = tx.merge(cust[["customer_id", "country"]], on="customer_id", how="left")

    sess = read_csv(
        "shopsphere_sessions_cleaned.csv", usecols=["customer_id", "session_timestamp"],
    )
    sess["month"] = parse_datetime(sess["session_timestamp"]).dt.to_period("M").dt.to_timestamp()
    sess = sess.merge(cust[["customer_id", "country"]], on="customer_id", how="left")
    active = sess.groupby(["month", "country"], dropna=False).agg(
        active_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()

    cm = tx.groupby(["customer_id", "country", "month"], dropna=False).agg(
        revenue=("order_value", "sum"),
        orders=("transaction_id", "nunique"),
        last_order=("date", "max"),
    ).reset_index().sort_values(["customer_id", "month"])
    cm["previous_order"] = cm.groupby("customer_id")["last_order"].shift()
    cm["days_since_previous_order"] = (
        cm["month"] - cm["previous_order"]
    ).dt.days
    cm["first_time_buyer"] = cm["previous_order"].isna()
    cm["reactivated_180d"] = cm["days_since_previous_order"].ge(180)
    cm["reactivated_365d"] = cm["days_since_previous_order"].ge(365)

    out = cm.groupby(["month", "country"], dropna=False).agg(
        revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
        orders=("orders", "sum"),
        buyers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        first_time_buyers=("first_time_buyer", "sum"),
        reactivated_180d=("reactivated_180d", "sum"),
        reactivated_365d=("reactivated_365d", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    out = out.merge(active, on=["month", "country"], how="left")
    out["active_customers"] = out["active_customers"].fillna(0)
    out["buyer_rate"] = out["buyers"] / out["active_customers"].replace(0, np.nan)
    out["reactivation_rate_180d"] = (
        out["reactivated_180d"] / out["buyers"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    out["reactivation_rate_365d"] = (
        out["reactivated_365d"] / out["buyers"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    out["aov"] = out["revenue"] / out["orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    prior = out[["country", "month", "revenue", "orders", "buyers", "reactivated_180d"]].copy()
    prior["month"] = prior["month"] + pd.DateOffset(years=1)
    prior = prior.rename(columns={
        "revenue": "revenue_prior_year",
        "orders": "orders_prior_year",
        "buyers": "buyers_prior_year",
        "reactivated_180d": "reactivated_180d_prior_year",
    })
    out = out.merge(prior, on=["country", "month"], how="left")
    for col in ["revenue", "orders", "buyers", "reactivated_180d"]:
        out[f"{col}_yoy_change"] = (
            out[col] / out[f"{col}_prior_year"].replace(0, np.nan) - 1
        )

    out["year"] = out["month"].dt.year
    out["month_num"] = out["month"].dt.month
    out["month_name"] = out["month"].dt.strftime("%b")
    out["is_holiday_season"] = out["month_num"].isin([11, 12])
    out["year_mean_revenue"] = out.groupby(["country", "year"])["revenue"].transform("mean")
    out["revenue_index_vs_year_mean"] = (
        out["revenue"] / out["year_mean_revenue"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    out = out.sort_values(["country", "month"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_seasonality_month.csv"), index=False)

    calendar = out.groupby(["month_num", "month_name"], dropna=False).agg(
        observations=("month", "size"),
        avg_revenue_index=("revenue_index_vs_year_mean", "mean"),
        avg_buyer_rate=("buyer_rate", "mean"),
        avg_reactivation_rate_180d=("reactivation_rate_180d", "mean"),
        avg_reactivation_rate_365d=("reactivation_rate_365d", "mean"),
        avg_yoy_revenue_change=("revenue_yoy_change", "mean"),
    ).reset_index().sort_values("month_num")
    calendar["is_holiday_season"] = calendar["month_num"].isin([11, 12])
    calendar.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_seasonality_calendar.csv"), index=False)
    return out, calendar


def w1_segments() -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    cur = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "current_customers.pkl"))
    keep = ["sample_ref", "cust_country", "cust_tier", "pref_channel", "w1_probability",

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pandas as pd

from shopsphere.common import DB_PATH, OUT_OUTPUTS, ensure_dirs

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batches (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    batch_ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    week_start TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    objective TEXT NOT NULL,
    budget_usd REAL,
    planned_contacts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    planned_spend REAL,
    expected_incremental_revenue REAL,
    expected_net_value REAL,
    expected_roi REAL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending',
    decided_by TEXT,
    decided_at TEXT,
    decision_reason TEXT,
    summary_json TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recommendations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sample_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    cust_country TEXT,
    cust_tier TEXT,
    channel TEXT,
    offer_code TEXT,
    offer_type TEXT,
    purchase_probability REAL,
    baseline_probability REAL,
    uplift REAL,
    redemption_probability REAL,
    expected_order_value REAL,
    offer_cost REAL,
    expected_incremental_revenue REAL,
    expected_net_value REAL,
    roi REAL,
    w1_probability REAL,
    priority_rank INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES batches(id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES batches(id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_recommendations_batch ON recommendations(batch_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_batch ON audit_log(batch_id);
"""


def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    ensure_dirs()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    return conn


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()


def py(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    if hasattr(value, "item"):
        return value.item()
    return value


def create_batch(plan: pd.DataFrame, summary: dict, created_by: str = "system") -> str:
    if plan is None or len(plan) == 0:
        raise ValueError("Cannot create an empty approval batch")
    if not str(created_by).strip():
        raise ValueError("created_by is required")
    batch_ref = (
        f"BATCH-{summary['week_start']}-{summary['country']}-"
        f"{datetime.now().strftime('%H%M%S')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4].upper()}"
    )
    conn = connect()
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            """INSERT INTO batches (
                batch_ref, created_at, created_by, week_start, country, objective,
                budget_usd, planned_contacts, planned_spend, expected_incremental_revenue,
                expected_net_value, expected_roi, status, summary_json
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Pending', ?)""",
            (
                batch_ref, now(), created_by, summary["week_start"], summary["country"],
                summary["objective"], py(summary.get("budget_usd")),
                int(summary["planned_contacts"]), py(summary.get("planned_spend")),
                py(summary.get("expected_incremental_revenue")),
                py(summary.get("expected_net_value")), py(summary.get("expected_roi")),
                json.dumps(summary, default=str),
            ),
        )
        batch_id = int(cur.lastrowid)
        rec_cols = [
            "sample_ref", "cust_country", "cust_tier", "channel", "offer_code",
            "offer_type", "purchase_probability", "baseline_probability", "uplift",
            "redemption_probability", "expected_order_value", "offer_cost",
            "expected_incremental_revenue", "expected_net_value", "roi",
            "w1_probability", "priority_rank",
        ]
        rows = []
        for _, r in plan.iterrows():
            rows.append(tuple([batch_id] + [py(r.get(c)) for c in rec_cols]))
        placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * (len(rec_cols) + 1))
        cur.executemany(
            f"INSERT INTO recommendations (batch_id, {', '.join(rec_cols)}) "
            f"VALUES ({placeholders})", rows,
        )
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_log (batch_id, action, actor, reason, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, 'created', ?, ?, ?)",
            (batch_id, created_by, f"Created batch with {len(plan)} recommendations", now()),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return batch_ref
    finally:
        conn.close()


def list_batches() -> pd.DataFrame:
    conn = connect()
    try:
        return pd.read_sql_query(
            "SELECT * FROM batches ORDER BY id DESC", conn,
        )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_batch(batch_ref: str) -> tuple[pd.Series, pd.DataFrame]:
    conn = connect()
    try:
        batch = pd.read_sql_query(
            "SELECT * FROM batches WHERE batch_ref = ?", conn, params=(batch_ref,),
        )
        if len(batch) == 0:
            raise KeyError(f"Unknown batch {batch_ref!r}")
        recs = pd.read_sql_query(
            "SELECT * FROM recommendations WHERE batch_id = ? ORDER BY priority_rank",
            conn, params=(int(batch["id"].iloc[0]),),
        )
        return batch.iloc[0], recs
    finally:
        conn.close()


def audit_trail(batch_ref: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    conn = connect()
    try:
        return pd.read_sql_query(
            """SELECT a.* FROM audit_log a
               JOIN batches b ON b.id = a.batch_id
               WHERE b.batch_ref = ? ORDER BY a.id""",
            conn, params=(batch_ref,),
        )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def decide_batch(batch_ref: str, decision: str, actor: str, reason: str) -> None:
    if decision not in ("Approved", "Rejected"):
        raise ValueError("decision must be Approved or Rejected")
    if not str(actor).strip():
        raise ValueError("actor is required")
    if not str(reason).strip():
        raise ValueError("reason is required")
    conn = connect()
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT id, status FROM batches WHERE batch_ref = ?", (batch_ref,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Unknown batch {batch_ref!r}")
        if row["status"] != "Pending":
            raise ValueError(f"Batch is already {row['status']}")
        cur.execute(
            """UPDATE batches SET status = ?, decided_by = ?, decided_at = ?,
               decision_reason = ? WHERE batch_ref = ?""",
            (decision, actor, now(), reason, batch_ref),
        )
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_log (batch_id, action, actor, reason, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (int(row["id"]), decision.lower(), actor, reason, now()),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def export_approved(batch_ref: str, path: str | None = None) -> str:
    batch, recs = get_batch(batch_ref)
    if batch["status"] != "Approved":
        raise ValueError("Only approved batches can be exported")
    if path is None:
        ensure_dirs()
        path = os.path.join(OUT_OUTPUTS, f"{batch_ref}_approved.csv")
    out = recs.drop(columns=["id", "batch_id"]).copy()
    out.insert(0, "batch_ref", batch_ref)
    out.insert(1, "week_start", batch["week_start"])
    out.insert(2, "country", batch["country"])
    out.to_csv(path, index=False)
    conn = connect()
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT id FROM batches WHERE batch_ref = ?", (batch_ref,))
        batch_id = int(cur.fetchone()["id"])
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_log (batch_id, action, actor, reason, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, 'exported', 'system', ?, ?)",
            (batch_id, os.path.basename(path), now()),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return path


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["init", "list"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.action == "init":
        connect().close()
        print("Initialized", DB_PATH)
    else:
        print(list_batches().to_string(index=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os

import altair as alt
import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st

from shopsphere.app import approvals
from shopsphere.common import FIXED_REPORTS, OUT_DATA, ROLLING_REPORTS, read_budget
from shopsphere.pipelines import planner

st.set_page_config(
    page_title="ShopSphere Retention Intelligence",
    page_icon=":bar_chart:",
    layout="wide",
)


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def load_csv(path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_csv(path)


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def load_json(path: str) -> dict:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        return json.load(fh)


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def load_scores() -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "offer_candidate_scores.parquet"))


def analytics(name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        st.error(f"Missing analytics file: {path}. Run build_analytics.py first.")
        st.stop()
    return load_csv(path)


def fmt_money(value) -> str:
    try:
        if pd.isna(value):
            return "n/a"
        return f"${float(value):,.0f}"
    except Exception:
        return "n/a"


def fmt_pct(value) -> str:
    try:
        if pd.isna(value):
            return "n/a"
        return f"{float(value):.1%}"
    except Exception:
        return "n/a"


def show_table(df: pd.DataFrame, columns: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    out = df[columns].copy() if columns else df.copy()
    st.dataframe(out, width="stretch", hide_index=True)


def tab_overview() -> None:
    st.subheader("Executive performance")
    daily = analytics("analytics_daily_country.csv")
    daily["date"] = pd.to_datetime(daily["date"])
    countries = sorted(daily["country"].dropna().unique())
    max_date = daily["date"].max().date()
    min_date = daily["date"].min().date()

    c1, c2, c3 = st.columns([1.1, 1.1, 2])
    date_range = c1.date_input(
        "Date range", value=(max_date - pd.Timedelta(days=89), max_date),
        min_value=min_date, max_value=max_date,
    )
    if isinstance(date_range, (tuple, list)) and len(date_range) == 2:
        start, end = date_range
    else:
        start = end = date_range
    selected = c2.multiselect("Countries", countries, default=countries)
    metric = c3.selectbox(
        "Trend metric", ["revenue", "orders", "sessions", "aov", "conversion_rate"],
        format_func=lambda x: {
            "revenue": "Revenue", "orders": "Orders", "sessions": "Sessions",
            "aov": "AOV", "conversion_rate": "Conversion rate",
        }[x],
    )
    d = daily[
        (daily["date"] >= pd.Timestamp(start)) & (daily["date"] <= pd.Timestamp(end)) &
        (daily["country"].isin(selected))
    ].copy()
    if d.empty:
        st.warning("No rows in the selected window.")
        return

    revenue = d["revenue"].sum()
    orders = d["orders"].sum()
    sessions = d["sessions"].sum()
    spend = d["campaign_spend"].sum()
    attr_rev = d["attributed_revenue"].sum()
    deliveries = d["deliveries"].sum()
    late = d["late_deliveries"].sum()
    k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6 = st.columns(6)
    k1.metric("Revenue", fmt_money(revenue))
    k2.metric("Orders", f"{orders:,.0f}")
    k3.metric("AOV", fmt_money(revenue / orders if orders else None))
    k4.metric("Conversion", fmt_pct(orders / sessions if sessions else None))
    k5.metric("Campaign ROAS", f"{attr_rev / spend:.2f}" if spend else "n/a")
    k6.metric("Late delivery", fmt_pct(late / deliveries if deliveries else None))

    chart = alt.Chart(d).mark_line(point=False).encode(
        x=alt.X("date:T", title=None),
        y=alt.Y(f"{metric}:Q", title=metric.replace("_", " ").title()),
        color=alt.Color("country:N", title="Country"),
        tooltip=["date:T", "country:N", alt.Tooltip(f"{metric}:Q", format=".3f")],
    ).properties(height=320)
    st.altair_chart(chart, width="stretch")

    left, right = st.columns(2)
    with left:
        st.markdown("**Country scorecard: last 90 days vs prior 90 days**")
        score = analytics("analytics_country_scorecard.csv")
        score = score[score["country"].isin(selected)]
        show = score[[
            "country", "revenue_last90", "revenue_change_pct", "orders_last90",
            "orders_change_pct", "aov_last90", "conversion_last90", "roas_last90",
            "late_rate_last90",
        ]].copy()
        show.columns = [
            "Country", "Revenue", "Revenue Δ", "Orders", "Orders Δ", "AOV",
            "Conversion", "ROAS", "Late rate",
        ]
        for col in ["Revenue", "AOV"]:
            show[col] = show[col].map(fmt_money)
        for col in ["Revenue Δ", "Orders Δ", "Conversion", "Late rate"]:
            show[col] = show[col].map(fmt_pct)
        show["ROAS"] = show["ROAS"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}" if pd.notna(x) else "n/a")
        show_table(show)
    with right:
        st.markdown("**Carrier reliability**")
        carrier = analytics("analytics_carrier.csv")
        carrier = carrier[carrier["country"].isin(selected)]
        show = carrier[[
            "country", "carrier", "deliveries", "late_rate", "lost_rate",
            "returned_rate", "avg_delay_days",
        ]].copy()
        show.columns = ["Country", "Carrier", "Deliveries", "Late", "Lost", "Returned", "Avg delay"]
        for col in ["Late", "Lost", "Returned"]:
            show[col] = show[col].map(fmt_pct)
        show["Avg delay"] = show["Avg delay"].map(
            lambda x: f"{x:.2f}d" if pd.notna(x) else "n/a"
        )
        show_table(show.sort_values(["Country", "Late"], ascending=[True, False]))


def tab_campaigns() -> None:
    st.subheader("Campaign effectiveness and incrementality")
    st.caption(
        "Attribution metrics are platform-attributed. The DiD view is a quasi-experimental "
        "region comparison and should not be read as a randomised causal estimate."
    )
    monthly = analytics("analytics_campaign_type.csv")
    monthly["month"] = pd.to_datetime(monthly["month"])
    types = sorted(monthly["campaign_type"].dropna().unique())
    selected = st.multiselect("Campaign types", types, default=types)
    m = monthly[monthly["campaign_type"].isin(selected)].copy()
    if m.empty:
        st.warning("No campaign rows.")
        return

    totals = m.groupby("campaign_type").agg(
        campaigns=("campaigns", "sum"), spend=("spend", "sum"),
        revenue=("attributed_revenue", "sum"), orders=("attributed_orders", "sum"),
        clicks=("clicks", "sum"), impressions=("impressions", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    totals["roas"] = totals["revenue"] / totals["spend"].replace(0, float("nan"))
    totals["cpa"] = totals["spend"] / totals["orders"].replace(0, float("nan"))
    totals["ctr"] = totals["clicks"] / totals["impressions"].replace(0, float("nan"))
    totals = totals.sort_values("roas", ascending=False)

    c1, c2 = st.columns([1, 1])
    with c1:
        bar = alt.Chart(totals).mark_bar().encode(
            x=alt.X("campaign_type:N", sort="-y", title=None),
            y=alt.Y("roas:Q", title="Attributed ROAS"),
            color=alt.Color("campaign_type:N", legend=None),
            tooltip=["campaign_type:N", alt.Tooltip("roas:Q", format=".2f"),
                     alt.Tooltip("spend:Q", format="$,.0f")],
        ).properties(height=300)
        st.altair_chart(bar, width="stretch")
    with c2:
        show = totals[["campaign_type", "spend", "revenue", "orders", "roas", "cpa", "ctr"]].copy()
        show.columns = ["Type", "Spend", "Revenue", "Orders", "ROAS", "CPA", "CTR"]
        show["Spend"] = show["Spend"].map(fmt_money)
        show["Revenue"] = show["Revenue"].map(fmt_money)
        show["ROAS"] = show["ROAS"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}")
        show["CPA"] = show["CPA"].map(fmt_money)
        show["CTR"] = show["CTR"].map(fmt_pct)
        show_table(show)

    trend = alt.Chart(m).mark_line(point=False).encode(
        x=alt.X("month:T", title=None),
        y=alt.Y("roas:Q", title="Monthly ROAS"),
        color=alt.Color("campaign_type:N", title="Type"),
        tooltip=["month:T", "campaign_type:N", alt.Tooltip("roas:Q", format=".2f")],
    ).properties(height=280)
    st.altair_chart(trend, width="stretch")

    st.divider()
    st.markdown("**Retention offer lift vs reminder-only (`OFF-NONE`)**")
    lift_path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_offer_lift.csv")
    if os.path.exists(lift_path):
        lift = load_csv(lift_path)
        base = alt.Chart(lift)
        bars = base.mark_bar(color="#2b8a9e").encode(
            x=alt.X("offer_code:N", sort="-y", title=None),
            y=alt.Y("adjusted_lift:Q", title="Adjusted purchase-rate lift"),
            tooltip=["offer_code:N", alt.Tooltip("adjusted_lift:Q", format=".3f"),
                     alt.Tooltip("contacts:Q", format=",.0f")],
        )
        rules = base.mark_rule(color="#333").encode(
            x="offer_code:N", y="lift_ci_low:Q", y2="lift_ci_high:Q",
        )
        st.altair_chart(bars + rules, width="stretch")
        show = lift.copy()
        show.columns = [
            "Offer", "Contacts", "Observed rate", "Baseline rate", "Adjusted lift",
            "CI low", "CI high", "Incremental purchases", "Redemption rate",
            "None rate",
        ]
        for col in ["Observed rate", "Baseline rate", "Adjusted lift", "CI low",
                    "CI high", "Redemption rate", "None rate"]:
            show[col] = show[col].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2%}")
        show["Incremental purchases"] = show["Incremental purchases"].map(lambda x: f"{x:,.1f}")
        show_table(show)
        st.caption(
            "Lift is direct-standardised to the offer group's tier × country × channel mix. "
            "Intervals crossing zero mean the offer effect is not distinguishable from no effect."
        )
    else:
        st.info("Run build_analytics.py to generate offer lift.")

    st.divider()
    st.markdown("**Regional campaign differences-in-differences**")
    did_path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_campaign_did.csv")
    if os.path.exists(did_path):
        did = load_csv(did_path)
        c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
        dcountry = c1.multiselect("DiD countries", sorted(did["country"].dropna().unique()),
                                  default=sorted(did["country"].dropna().unique()))
        dtype = c2.multiselect("DiD types", sorted(did["campaign_type"].dropna().unique()),
                               default=sorted(did["campaign_type"].dropna().unique()))
        view = did[did["country"].isin(dcountry) & did["campaign_type"].isin(dtype)].copy()
        view = view.sort_values("relative_lift", ascending=False)
        view = view[[
            "campaign_id", "campaign_type", "country", "target_region", "start_date",
            "end_date", "post_days", "n_control_regions", "did_daily_revenue",
            "relative_lift", "target_pre_orders", "target_post_orders",
        ]].copy()
        view.columns = [
            "Campaign", "Type", "Country", "Target region", "Start", "End", "Days",
            "Controls", "DiD daily revenue", "Relative lift", "Target pre orders",
            "Target post orders",
        ]
        view["DiD daily revenue"] = view["DiD daily revenue"].map(fmt_money)
        view["Relative lift"] = view["Relative lift"].map(fmt_pct)
        show_table(view.head(100))
    else:
        st.info("Run build_analytics.py to generate DiD results.")


def tab_seasonality() -> None:
    st.subheader("Seasonality: months and years")
    st.caption(
        "Revenue is strongly seasonal: November (Singles' Day / Black Friday) and December are "
        "the busiest months, and dormant customers are more likely to return then. Use this view "
        "so a seasonal lull is not mistaken for churn, and so incentives are not spent on demand "
        "that would have happened anyway."
    )
    month = analytics("analytics_seasonality_month.csv")
    month["month"] = pd.to_datetime(month["month"])
    calendar = analytics("analytics_seasonality_calendar.csv")
    month_order = calendar.sort_values("month_num")["month_name"].tolist()

    countries = sorted(month["country"].dropna().unique())
    selected = st.multiselect("Countries", countries, default=countries,
                              key="seasonality_countries")
    m = month[month["country"].isin(selected)].copy()
    if m.empty:
        st.warning("No rows in the selected countries.")
        return

    holiday = calendar[calendar["is_holiday_season"]]
    nonholiday = calendar[~calendar["is_holiday_season"]]
    peak = calendar.loc[calendar["avg_revenue_index"].idxmax()]
    k1, k2, k3, k4 = st.columns(4)
    k1.metric("Holiday revenue index", f"{holiday['avg_revenue_index'].mean():.2f}x")
    k2.metric("Peak month", f"{peak['month_name']} ({peak['avg_revenue_index']:.2f}x)")
    k3.metric("Holiday reactivation (180d)",
              fmt_pct(holiday["avg_reactivation_rate_180d"].mean()))
    k4.metric("Non-holiday reactivation",
              fmt_pct(nonholiday["avg_reactivation_rate_180d"].mean()))

    c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
    with c1:
        st.markdown("**Average monthly revenue index vs that year's mean**")
        bar = alt.Chart(calendar).mark_bar().encode(
            x=alt.X("month_name:N", sort=month_order, title=None),
            y=alt.Y("avg_revenue_index:Q", title="Revenue index"),
            color=alt.Color(
                "is_holiday_season:N",
                scale=alt.Scale(domain=[False, True], range=["#9ecae1", "#e6550d"]),
                legend=alt.Legend(title="Holiday season"),
            ),
            tooltip=["month_name:N", alt.Tooltip("avg_revenue_index:Q", format=".2f"),
                     alt.Tooltip("avg_reactivation_rate_180d:Q", format=".3f")],
        ).properties(height=300)
        st.altair_chart(bar, width="stretch")
    with c2:
        st.markdown("**Dormant-customer reactivation rate (180d) by month**")
        line = alt.Chart(calendar).mark_line(point=True).encode(
            x=alt.X("month_name:N", sort=month_order, title=None),
            y=alt.Y("avg_reactivation_rate_180d:Q", title="Reactivation rate",
                    axis=alt.Axis(format="%")),
            tooltip=["month_name:N",
                     alt.Tooltip("avg_reactivation_rate_180d:Q", format=".3%")],
        ).properties(height=300)
        st.altair_chart(line, width="stretch")

    st.markdown("**Monthly revenue index by country and year**")
    heat = alt.Chart(m).mark_rect().encode(
        x=alt.X("year:O", title=None),
        y=alt.Y("month_name:N", sort=month_order, title=None),
        color=alt.Color(
            "revenue_index_vs_year_mean:Q", title="Index vs year mean",
            scale=alt.Scale(scheme="orangered"),
        ),
        tooltip=["country:N", "year:O", "month_name:N",
                 alt.Tooltip("revenue:Q", format="$,.0f"),
                 alt.Tooltip("revenue_index_vs_year_mean:Q", format=".2f"),
                 alt.Tooltip("revenue_yoy_change:Q", format=".1%")],
    ).properties(height=320)
    st.altair_chart(heat, width="stretch")

    st.markdown("**Year-over-year revenue change by month**")
    yoy = m.dropna(subset=["revenue_yoy_change"]).copy()
    if yoy.empty:
        st.info("No year-over-year pairs available for the selected countries.")
    else:
        trend = alt.Chart(yoy).mark_line(point=True).encode(
            x=alt.X("month:T", title=None),
            y=alt.Y("revenue_yoy_change:Q", title="YoY change", axis=alt.Axis(format="%")),
            color=alt.Color("country:N", title="Country"),
            tooltip=["month:T", "country:N",
                     alt.Tooltip("revenue_yoy_change:Q", format=".1%")],
        ).properties(height=280)
        st.altair_chart(trend, width="stretch")

    st.markdown("**Seasonal calendar (all countries)**")

    show["Expected net"] = show["Expected net"].map(fmt_money)

    k1, k2, k3, k4 = st.columns(4)
    k1.metric("Status", batch["status"])
    k2.metric("Contacts", f"{int(batch['planned_contacts']):,}")
    k3.metric("Expected spend", fmt_money(batch["planned_spend"]))
    k4.metric("Expected net", fmt_money(batch["expected_net_value"]))

    display = recs[[
        "priority_rank", "sample_ref", "cust_tier", "channel", "offer_code", "uplift",
        "expected_order_value", "offer_cost", "expected_net_value", "roi",
    ]].copy()
    display.columns = [
        "Rank", "Sample ref", "Tier", "Channel", "Offer", "Uplift",
        "Expected order value", "Expected cost", "Expected net", "ROI",
    ]
    display["Uplift"] = display["Uplift"].map(fmt_pct)
    for col in ["Expected order value", "Expected cost", "Expected net"]:
        display[col] = display[col].map(fmt_money)
    display["ROI"] = display["ROI"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}" if pd.notna(x) else "n/a")
    show_table(display.head(500))

    st.markdown("**Audit trail**")
    trail = approvals.audit_trail(selected)
    if trail.empty:
        st.caption("No audit events.")
    else:
        trail = trail[["created_at", "action", "actor", "reason"]].copy()
        trail.columns = ["Time", "Action", "Actor", "Reason"]
        show_table(trail)

    if batch["status"] == "Pending":
        with st.form("approval_form"):
            decision = st.radio("Decision", ["Approved", "Rejected"], horizontal=True)
            actor = st.text_input("Reviewer name")
            reason = st.text_area("Reason for decision")
            submitted = st.form_submit_button("Record decision", type="primary")
        if submitted:
            try:
                approvals.decide_batch(selected, decision, actor, reason)
                st.success(f"{selected} marked {decision}.")
                st.rerun()
            except Exception as exc:

display.text:
# ShopSphere - Week 8 Model Checkpoint Report

**Course:** IT2226 AI Innovation & Deep Learning  
**Project:** ShopSphere customer purchase propensity and retention outreach  
**Deliverable:** Week 8 checkpoint - model, evaluation, first test submission

> **Sample framing.** The dataset is a sample of the customer base, not a full census.
> Results describe segment-level tendencies and are not used to make decisions about
> individual customers. The analysis and dashboard contain no customer IDs or individual
> lookup.

## 1. Objective

Estimate the probability that a sampled customer purchases in the 30 days after the
**2024-09-30** data cutoff (October 2024 window) so retention effort can be prioritised by
segment. The modelling grain is one row per sampled customer: 64,000 training rows (14.6%
positive) and 16,000 disjoint test rows.

## 2. Data preparation and features

- Sixteen cleaned source tables are used (sessions, transactions, items, delivery, support,
  returns, retention contacts, registration, customer and geography, offers, budget).
- Cleaning follows one convention: ISO dates, quoted booleans, `_clean` categorical fields,
  exact duplicates removed, invalid values blanked, IQR caps only on duration-like fields.
- **180 customer-level features** (174 numeric, 6 categorical) are built strictly from data
  on or before the cutoff, then one-hot encoded and scaled to a 294-column matrix.
- **Seasonality is modelled explicitly.** Because the data spans January 2022 to September
  2024, the pipeline adds historical October and Nov-Dec behaviour per customer: October
  transaction/session counts and shares, holiday-season shares, monthly seasonality indices,
  days since the last October purchase, and a dormant × holiday-affinity interaction. The
  target window is October, so prior-October activity is a direct seasonal signal; holiday
  affinity captures seasonal shoppers who are otherwise inactive.
- The train/test split is provided and disjoint, and the target is in the future window, so
  there is no target leakage.

## 3. Models and validation

A stratified 80/20 split of the training sample gives 51,200 fit rows and 12,800 validation
rows. Because positives are only 14.6%, **PR-AUC** is the primary metric; ROC-AUC, F1,
precision, recall, log loss and Brier score are also reported. Classification thresholds are
tuned on validation F1.

| Model | ROC-AUC | PR-AUC | F1 | Precision | Recall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dummy prior | 0.5000 | 0.1457 | 0.2544 | 0.1457 | 1.0000 |
| Logistic regression | 0.8718 | 0.5692 | 0.5398 | 0.4772 | 0.6215 |
| Gradient boosting (HGB) | 0.8750 | 0.5734 | 0.5450 | 0.5155 | 0.5780 |
| **Deep MLP (3-seed ensemble)** | 0.8722 | 0.5716 | 0.5418 | 0.4759 | 0.6290 |
| **Ensemble (MLP + HGB) - selected** | **0.8756** | **0.5760** | **0.5471** | 0.5147 | 0.5839 |
| Ensemble (MLP + HGB + LogReg) | 0.8755 | 0.5760 | 0.5453 | 0.4694 | 0.6504 |

The selected model is the **blend of the deep MLP and gradient boosting** (threshold 0.706).
It gives the best PR-AUC and F1 among the strong models. On the test sample it flags
**2,650 of 16,000 rows (16.6%)**. Adding the seasonality features improved validation PR-AUC
from 0.5730 to 0.5760 and ROC-AUC from 0.8747 to 0.8756.

### Deep-learning model

A 256-128-64 MLP with batch normalisation, dropout, class-weighted binary cross-entropy,
AdamW and early stopping. Three seeds are trained and averaged, which reduces variance.
Validation PR-AUC peaks within 3-5 epochs and then overfits, so early stopping restores each
seed's best epoch. Blending with gradient boosting improves ranking stability over the MLP
alone.

### Main drivers

Permutation importance on the boosted model is dominated by behavioural recency and
frequency: sessions in the last 180 days, days since the last session, monthly average
session volume, loyalty score and tenure. Transaction spend/recency and support experience
follow. Seasonality features are used: `sess_monthly_mean` is the third most important
feature and `sess_oct_share` also enters the top ten, confirming that prior-October browsing
adds signal beyond recency alone.

### Seasonality check

Monthly revenue is strongly seasonal. Relative to the average month in the same country-year,
November averages **1.59x** and December **2.22x** (holiday average **1.90x**), while January
averages **0.64x**. Dormant customers also return in the peak: buyers whose previous order was
180+ days earlier are a larger share of buyers in Nov-Dec than in the off-season. This is why
the model includes month-aware features and why the retention planner applies a seasonal
demand adjustment instead of treating every week as average.

## 4. Segment analysis

Because the data is a sample, results are interpreted as segment estimates. Grouping by tier
shows a clear gradient: **Bronze is 64% of the sample but only 34% of expected buyers**, while
**Platinum is 8% of the sample but 19% of expected buyers**.

| Tier | Sample customers | Mean propensity | Share of expected buyers | Flag rate at 0.706 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bronze | 10,198 | 0.181 | 34.3% | 1.9% |
| Silver | 2,830 | 0.499 | 26.2% | 19.9% |
| Gold | 1,670 | 0.656 | 20.3% | 52.5% |
| Platinum | 1,302 | 0.799 | 19.3% | 78.3% |

Country is much less differentiating than tier: mean propensity is 0.32-0.35 across US, UK,
DE, FR and IN, with expected-buyer shares roughly tracking sample size (US 40%, UK 20%,
DE 20%, FR 10%, IN 10%).

### Customers who fall into multiple groups

Intersecting dimensions is more useful than any single cut. The table below uses **all
conditions at once** (e.g. Bronze AND active AND high session volume).

| Segment (all conditions) | Customers | Mean propensity | Share of expected buyers | Flag rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Email opt-in + high sessions | 3,132 | 0.753 | 43.7% | 65.8% |
| Bronze + email opt-in | 6,377 | 0.201 | 23.8% | 2.4% |
| Bronze + dormant | 4,594 | 0.041 | 3.5% | 0.0% |
| High loyalty + cooling | 548 | 0.600 | 6.1% | 24.8% |
| Gold/Silver + recent complaint | 221 | 0.667 | 2.7% | 49.3% |
| Bronze + active + high sessions | 197 | 0.651 | 2.4% | 35.0% |
| Open complaint (all tiers) | 70 | 0.442 | 0.6% | 28.6% |

Interpretation:

- **Email opt-in + high sessions** is about one fifth of the sample but carries **44% of
  expected buyers** - the best broad target for a consented campaign.
- **Bronze + email opt-in** is large (6,377) but low propensity (0.201); it is a reach play,
  not a high-yield one.
- **Bronze + active + high sessions** is a small niche (197) with high propensity (0.651) -
  a useful lookalike definition.
- **Bronze + dormant** (4,594) has almost no expected buyers; suppress or use a low-cost
  reactivation test only.
- **Gold/Silver + recent complaint** (221, propensity 0.667) should go to service recovery
  rather than a generic promotion.

## 5. Fairness and responsible use

- **No customer IDs or individual lookup** appear in the analysis, dashboard or exports;
  all reporting is aggregated by segment.
- **No direct identifiers** (name, email, phone) are used as features.
- **Consent:** customers with `do_not_contact` are never selected for outreach.
- **Service fairness:** customers with open complaints are excluded from promotional contact
  and routed to service recovery instead.
- **Monitoring:** selection rate is reported by country, tier and intersection segments.
  Large gaps should be reviewed before launch.
- **Predictive, not causal:** propensity ranks likely buyers; it does not estimate uplift.
  A randomised segment holdout is required before scaling incentives.
- **Human oversight:** high-value and complaint-related segments should require approval.

## 6. Agentic component (preview)

The Week 8 build includes a deterministic **policy layer** that the agent will call as a
tool. It takes propensity scores and applies:

1. consent/DNC and channel eligibility,
2. open-complaint and recent-contact suppression,
3. tier-based offer eligibility (20% / 15% voucher, free shipping, service-recovery credit),
4. weekly per-country budget caps and a maximum contact count.

Filtering happens at row level, but the output is an **aggregated segment plan** (country x
tier x offer x channel) with no customer IDs. The interactive dashboard exposes this planner,
including a policy funnel and audit trail. The next iteration wraps it as an agent tool with
an LLM reasoner for offer explanation and a human approval step.

## 7. Deliverables

| Artifact | Path |
|---|---|
| Executed checkpoint notebook | `notebooks/Week8_ShopSphere_Model_Checkpoint.ipynb` |
| Short report | `artifacts/reports/fixed/Week8_model_report.md` |
| Interactive segment explorer/tester | `archive/legacy_dashboard.py` |
| Trained models | `artifacts/models/fixed/` (preprocessor, logreg, HGB, 3 MLP seeds) |
| Metrics and predictions | `artifacts/reports/fixed/` |
| First test submission | `artifacts/outputs/submission.csv` (16,000 rows, 2,650 positives) |

## 8. Run commands

```powershell
# from the ShopSphere project root
py -m streamlit run archive/legacy_dashboard.py   # interactive segment viewer/tester
$env:PYTHONPATH="$PWD\src"; py -m shopsphere.models.train_models  # retrain + rewrite submission
```

## 9. Limitations and next steps

- **Sample, not census:** estimates describe segment tendencies; widen or reweight the
  sample before making population claims.
- **Causal vs predictive:** run a randomised segment holdout to measure incremental uplift.
- **Temporal drift:** validate on the next 30-day window and monitor calibration monthly.
- **Deep model:** try categorical embeddings and target encoding for high-cardinality fields.
- **Ensembling:** replace the fixed blend weight with a stacked meta-learner on out-of-fold
  scores.
- **Agent:** complete tool calling, explanation, guardrails and approvals.

6: # # ShopSphere - Week 8 Model Checkpoint
7: #
8: # **IT2226 AI Innovation & Deep Learning**
9: #
10: # Predict whether a customer purchases in the 30 days after **2024-09-30** (October 2024).
11: #
12: # > **Sample framing.** The dataset is a sample of the customer base, not a full census.
13: # > Results describe segment-level tendencies and are not used to make decisions about
14: # > individual customers. No customer IDs appear in this notebook.
15: #
16: # | Item | Value |
17: # |---|---|

19: # | Train / validation / test | 64,000 / 12,800 / 16,000 |
20: # | Target rate (train) | 14.6% |

24: import json
25: from pathlib import Path
26: 
27: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
28: import numpy as np
29: import pandas as pd
30: from sklearn.metrics import (ConfusionMatrixDisplay, average_precision_score,
31:                              confusion_matrix, precision_recall_curve, roc_curve,
32:                              roc_auc_score)
33: 
34: pd.set_option("display.width", 160)

38: BASE = Path.cwd()
39: if not (BASE / "artifacts").exists():
40:     BASE = BASE / "ShopSphere"
41: REPORTS = BASE / "artifacts" / "reports" / "fixed"
42: FEAT = BASE / "artifacts" / "features"
43: DATA = BASE / "data" / "clean"

45: metrics = json.loads((REPORTS / "metrics.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
46: comp = pd.read_csv(REPORTS / "model_comparison.csv").sort_values("pr_auc", ascending=False)
47: val = pd.read_csv(REPORTS / "validation_predictions.csv")
48: SEL, THR = metrics["selected_model"], metrics["selected_threshold"]

50: print(f"Selected model : {SEL}")
51: print(f"Threshold      : {THR:.3f}")
52: print(f"Split          : {metrics['split']}")
53: print(f"Test positives : {metrics['submission_positives']:,} ({metrics['submission_positive_rate']:.1%})")

56: # ## 1. Data and leakage control
57: #
58: # All features are built from data on or before the 2024-09-30 cutoff. The 64,000 train and
59: # 16,000 test rows are disjoint samples, and the target is purchases in the following 30-day
60: # window, so there is no target leakage. Sixteen cleaned source tables feed 156 customer-level
61: # features (150 numeric, 6 categorical).
62: 
63: 
64: rows = []
65: for p in sorted(DATA.glob("*.csv")):
66:     if p.name == "sample_submission.csv":
67:         continue
68:     with open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as fh:
69:         rows.append({"table": p.stem, "rows": sum(1 for _ in fh) - 1})
70: inventory = pd.DataFrame(rows)
71: display(inventory)
72: print("total rows:", f"{inventory['rows'].sum():,}", "| tables:", len(inventory))
73:
